![Natural Mined Diamonds: What They Are and Why They Matter ...](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/09171306-2330-0066-0000-4c05240eddf7:4)
Natural mined diamonds are `precious gemstones formed deep within the earth over billions of years under extreme heat and pressure`.[[1]](https://www.jared.com/lab-grown-vs-natural-diamonds)

### Key Characteristics

- **Composition:** Made of pure crystallized carbon.
- **Origin:** Formed 90 to 150 miles below the earth's surface and brought up by volcanic activity.
- **Rarity:** Limited supply makes them unique and generally more valuable over time compared to lab-grown alternatives.
- **Identification:** Contain tiny trace amounts of nitrogen that distinguish them from most lab-created stones.[[1]](https://www.cleanorigin.com/naturaldiamonds/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k0U-5Q7iKoE&t=35)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:10373165566595344437,catalogid:10619922960613418792,gpcid:14982875160004203472,mid:576462525223582652&ibp=oshop)[[4]](https://www.gia.edu/diamond)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ldYXdGxTHBU&t=17)[[6]](https://www.nathanalanjewelers.com/lab-diamonds-vs-natural-diamonds)

You can browse certified options through platforms like [Ritani](https://www.ritani.com/collections/diamonds) or learn more about geological formation from the [Gemological Institute of America](https://www.gia.edu/diamond).[[1]](https://www.ritani.com/collections/diamonds)[[2]](https://www.gia.edu/diamond)If you are looking to purchase a natural diamond, please let me know:

- Your target **budget** 
- Preferred **carat size** and **shape** (e.g., round, oval, princess)
- What kind of **setting or jewelry piece** you need

I can help you find suitable options or narrow down the right specs.
